rapport_notes: Joanna is warm, empathetic (acknowledges baby in car), patient with customer hesitations, and conversational throughout.
process_discipline_notes: Joanna repeated the 'no hidden fees' / all-inclusive message twice in rapid succession during the Stage 1 pricing explanation (not a differentiator repeat, but violates conciseness; this is a minor violation flagged for transparency).

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep launches into profile verification and logistics probing immediately with no opening framing of time commitment or promise of an accurate quote.
evidence_quotes.agenda: Asked late: 'Do you have any special instructions, concerns or stressors about moving in general or about this move that you want me to take note of at this time' — this comes after 3+ minutes of logistics probing (storage size, contents, access, boxes, destination layout).
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raises cost concern ('cost is important cause we spent quite a bit of money...') and Joanna acknowledges it ('Of course, understood') but does not follow with 'tell me more' or probe deeper into what 'affordable' means or what budget they had in mind. No second-layer follow-up on any concern raised.
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with: Covered in Stage 1 pricing pitch: 'we also include other features like our no worries, damage coverage which would give you up to, to $2,000 coverage for any repair replacement reimbursement for any accidental damages.'
evidence_quotes.sheet2_whos_coming: Covered in Stage 1 pricing pitch: 'Meet your mover feature. Rest assured we don't take daily contract to workers. Our guys are the most we vetted movers in the industry and we'll send you their names ahead of time to let you know who's coming to help out with the move.'
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: Covered in Stage 1 pricing pitch: 'lastly on time guarantee if we run late on the time we schedule, we provide discounts by the end of the day.'
evidence_quotes.communication: Not covered anywhere in the call. No mention of day-before call, named crew lead, inbox updates, or any proactive communication feature.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Delivered in Stage 3: 'typically a ten by twenty storage usually takes seven and a half to nine and a half hours to complete with three guys' (range anchored), then personalized: 'Now as you have mentioned, if you're planning to move some of the smaller items yourself, then definitely, that will make things quicker' and 'both of this is that, of course, the quicker the move gets the lower the cost. So just depending on how much items you're gonna try to get ahead.'
evidence_quotes.beats_it_pay_less: Delivered in Stage 3: 'if we go over the minimum we only charge in fifteen minute increments.'
evidence_quotes.self_prep_tip: Delivered in Stage 3: 'Mean, since how we work at gores that we charge by the hour. If you're planning to move the smaller items yourself, or any items yourself, that's totally fine, that would definitely help make things quicker and at the end of the day, the quick rate will be the shorter to the cost.'
evidence_quotes.estimate_is_a_window: Delivered in Stage 3: 'At the end of the day you only pay for how long it takes after the two and a half hour minimum' and 'the quicker the move gets the lower the cost. So just depending on how much items you're gonna try to get ahead.'
evidence_quotes.close_missing: Call ends with 'I'll go ahead and send everything in email. Okay. Bye.' — no rate-lock mention, no explicit 'would you like our help with your move' or equivalent ask. Customer is never asked to commit or book.

top_strength: Joanna delivered a complete, clear pricing and feature walkthrough (damage coverage, Meet Your Mover, On-Time Guarantee, all-inclusive rates, minimum and increments) early and confidently, anchoring the estimate range with smart personalization to the customer's stated prep plans.
coaching_note: Joanna skipped the quid pro quo framing entirely and asked the customer's agenda only after extensive logistics probing—both critical early moves—and failed to probe deeper when cost concerns emerged; she also never mentioned communication/day-before call and did not close with a rate-lock and explicit booking ask, leaving the call open-ended without commitment.
